review_scope: All eight source files, all four production files and all four test files; source-level wrapper checks included. Separate wrapper/provenance reviewer supplies additional lifecycle depth; no claim of actual qualification.

pending_blockers.detail: strconv is imported and has no reference anywhere in this file. This Windows source cannot compile.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Remove the unused import in a new frozen revision; preserve rev2. Root-owned compile evidence remains separate.

pending_blockers.detail: Final partial-file Sync/Close errors remain only in qualificationStream.err. CleanupComplete checks out.Err but not either stream.err; qualificationCaptureReason also ignores them. A fully received valid transcript with drained=true and a final persistence error can therefore qualify once the child has exited with code0 and JobZero. Even the branch that kills on stream.err does not make the error sticky.
pending_blockers.counterexample: Completed valid transcript reaches EOF; final partial.Sync or Close fails. Stream still has drained=true and a full hash. Root already exited0, so kill has no relevant effect. Capture can have CleanupComplete=true and reason empty.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Fold all stdout/stderr errors into terminal capture failure regardless of arrival phase; prohibit complete hashes/qualification on failed durable persistence. Add injected EOF-final-Sync/Close and post-root-exit stream-error cases.

pending_blockers.detail: The paired StdoutPrefix/StderrPrefix fields share json:"stdout_prefix" and paired hashes share json:"stdout_hash". encoding/json treats the competing fields as ambiguous and omits them. More broadly, the terminal record contains capture status only: actual plan/nonce/IPv4 tuple, rendered argv or digest, originating Task/Run/epoch/source/native/helper/template/build bindings, evaluated cases, Host controls and queried Job-limit evidence are not persisted. The live obs hash is not an independently reviewable run receipt.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Give each field a distinct explicit JSON tag. Persist a bounded Host-owned preparation/terminal record binding actual plan and identity, the ordered argv/projection hash, baselines/controls/case outcomes, precise diagnostic errors and requested/queried limits before admission. Do not make this record importable as authority. Assert serialized keys and bindings, not only exclusive-file behavior.

pending_blockers.detail: Stream ingestion always reads an 8192-byte buffer before checking the 1MiB cap, so bytes beyond the hard ingestion budget are consumed/discarded. The listener uses ReadString with a 128-byte buffer, which does not impose a 128-byte line limit. On stream-drain timeout, the collector sets local readiness booleans and returns without closing and joining outstanding readers, permitting capture writes after terminal return.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Clamp read slices to remaining capacity and fail closed at the ceiling; bound the listener line with a limited read and explicit oversize classification. On timeout close owned read handles and collect/join worker termination under the cleanup budget before publishing terminal state. Preserve partial diagnostics and never claim drained on uncertainty.

pending_blockers.detail: Read and existing-file write controls are implemented, but exact fixed CREATE_NEW targets have only absence checks, with no matched Host create-positive pre/post controls. A target-specific denial is not distinguished from the requested sandbox effect. Also the mutable reason string can overwrite a proven forbidden success with later CONTROL_INVALID/INCOMPLETE/IDENTITY_CHANGED; map iteration over case results makes final classification order-dependent. These paths remain closed, but lose the required violation evidence and finite-probe attribution.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Add bounded Host create controls for the exact synthetic targets, restoring absence before the child and only after first preserving any forbidden-create evidence during post-audit. Keep an immutable list/bitmap of observed violations and errors; choose deterministic precedence without erasing a forbidden success. Add actual Host-control/evaluator negative fixtures, including wrong errno, changed bytes, failed controls and simultaneous violation+incomplete cases.

pending_blockers.detail: exactReal compares EvalSymlinks output with the supplied spelling. It does not inspect FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT for every ancestor and leaf; reparse kinds that do not produce a changed resolved spelling are not explicitly refused. This does not implement the contract's ancestor no-reparse invariant for S/QW/D/helper.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Before qualification, inspect each authorized ancestor and relevant leaf with a narrow Windows attributes/handle check and reject every reparse tag, then perform canonical equality and record identities. Recheck the fixed fixture paths before accepting post-audit. No traversal of unrelated user directories is needed.

pending_blockers.detail: Wrapper Start performs only partial Launch checks before ensureLaunch can start Native. Canonical positive epoch, prompt nonblank/maximum length, and required callbacks are not checked until delegated B1.Start. Invalid trusted-Go input can consume a Native qualification and mutate fixtures before B1 rejects it. The independent wrapper reviewer reported this same issue; this report inspected the partial validation and cross-references that finding without recounting it.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Mirror or reuse B1's pure full launch preflight before state consumption/preparation/Native spawn, without editing B1-owned files in this lease. Add invalid-launch cases proving no qualification and no RPC creation. Coordinate exact origin with the supplemental reviewer.

positive_findings: Rev2 consumes first Ensure attempt even when identity validation fails; private live observation is not reconstructed from JSON.
Constructor composes ordinary NewCodexRPC with a private concrete provider; old nil path stays closed. Qualification receipt directory does not precreate B1 launch.Directory.

Helper uses fixed seven cases only; actual source digest, denied open, Win32 GENERIC_WRITE/OPEN_EXISTING and CREATE_NEW, and one IPv4 TCP tuple. No shell/interpreter/generic command or expected digest in helper input.
Canonical roundtrip plan/transcript validation enforces size, exact field representation, ordered START/RESULT and complete bitmap. Unrecognized stdout and nonempty stderr block success.
Host performs source/denied reads, existing-file write/restore checks and nonce-labelled IPv4 pre/post roundtrips. Unexpected accept blocks success.

Qualification argv preserves B1 ordered config arguments and replaces only validated app-server suffix with sandbox --include-managed-config --permission-profile nonce -C QW -- helper --plan-v1 encoded. No windows subcommand, new grants or unsafe fallback.

Job applies KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE plus active-process16 and Job-commit2048MiB and verifies via QueryInformationJobObject before launch. These are active count/commit limits, not cumulative process count/RSS.
One qualification attempt is consumed; wrapper subtracts preparation elapsed time before delegating B1. Helper watchdog10s and loopback connect1s are explicit.
test_coverage_limits: No tests executed. Existing source tests cover plan/canonical framing, narrow helper operations, Ensure identity and private failure accessor, small/overflow local fake collector.
No current test exercises whole wrapper phase handoff or full Host ensureLaunch/evaluator with all controls. Supplemental reviewer owns deeper wrapper analysis.
No final Sync/Close-failure injection, exact-cap ingestion accounting, unterminated listener-line bound, forced reader-drain join, or serialized receipt-field assertions found.
runtime_prerequisites: Fix blockers in a new freeze; preserve originals and any Root test failure. Root registers all Go/fake runs separately.
Host factory, shipped helper build/hash and authorized synthetic S binding remain a separate serial wiring scope; this source cannot self-authorize them.
Finite synthetic S/D/QW and one IPv4 tuple observations do not prove a complete Native permission graph or universal isolation. B1 same-process nonce barrier and B2 final fence remain mandatory.
No Native/model execution, setup, credential read or old echo/task replay authorized by this review. Normal Native platform-context limitations D03 remain.
